# ThrustCurve.org

> Certified model and high-power rocket motor data. Retrieve it from the JSON API. HTML pages are behind Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode and are not a corpus.

No API key. Cache responses for at least 24 hours. Stay under one request per second; a 429 means back off.

Field names, units, required properties, and `source_url` are the OpenAPI definitions in [swagger.json](https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/swagger.json). Copy those property names.

## Retrieve

1. Vocabulary, once, GET [metadata](https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/metadata.json?availability=available). Copy search values from `MetadataResponse`.
2. Motor records: POST a `SearchRequest` to `https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/search.json`. Read `SearchResponse`.
3. Thrust curve, when the question needs the time series: POST a `DownloadRequest` to `https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/download.json`. Read `DownloadResponse`.
4. Motors for a rocket: POST a `MotorGuideRequest` to `https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/motorguide.json`. Read `MotorGuideResponse`.

POST the JSON body. The `.json` path selects the parser. A designation such as `1/2A6` is the JSON string `SearchRequest.designation`.

### Search

```
POST https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/search.json
{"commonName":"C6","manufacturer":"Estes","maxResults":20}
```

An Estes C6-5 is that query. `C6-5` is common name `C6` and ejection delay 5. Keep the result when `delays` contains a `5` entry. The stored designation is `C6`.

```
POST https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/search.json
{"designation":"1/2A6","availability":"available","maxResults":20}
```

A fractional motor is a `designation`, then the same delay check. These names are rejected as `commonName`.

### Curve samples

```
POST https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/download.json
{"motorId":"MOTOR_ID","data":"samples"}
```

### Motors for a rocket

POST `https://www.thrustcurve.org/api/v1/motorguide.json`

```
{"rocket":{"bodyDiameterM":0.025,"mmtDiameterMm":18,"mmtLengthMm":70,"weightKg":0.045,"cd":0.25,"guideLengthM":1},"availability":"available"}
```

The numbers in the example are assumptions when the question does not give them; say which values you used.

## Cite

Quote `source_url`, manufacturer, designation, and the measured numbers from the definition for that response. Account endpoints (`getrockets`, `saverockets`) are private.
